title: The iso-memory frontier and the RandomPolicy control
gate_to_run: MODEL LADDER DONE and HAWKING SHIPPABLE

hypotheses.H1: Non-uniform allocation beats uniform allocation at equal bytes.
hypotheses.H2: Capability-conditioned allocation beats arbitrary non-uniform allocation at equal bytes (Math vs Random).
hypotheses.H3: Capability elimination beats capability allocation at equal bytes (MathNarrow vs Math).

sampling_policy.iso_memory_pair: H08 flagship vs H15 build-first at matched bytes

metrics.primary: Math Profile v1 aggregate G1-G8; G3 and G8 discriminating

analysis_plan: Compare arms at matched bytes only. H1 Uniform vs General/Math. H2 Math vs Random (credibility arm). H3 MathNarrow vs Math. Headline = bit gap between Uniform cliff and Math cliff.
stopping_rule: Full grid on Qwen3.5 first; stop when H2 resolves at >=3 bitrates or capacity kill K6 fires. No new arms/bitrates post-hoc without PROM-002.

what_would_falsify.H1: Uniform indistinguishable from General and Math at matched bytes.
what_would_falsify.H2: Math indistinguishable from Random at matched bytes (Claim A false).
what_would_falsify.H3: MathNarrow indistinguishable from Math at matched bytes.
what_would_falsify.machinery_invalid: Random arm fails to reconcile to Math byte total (pipeline asserts against this).
